verdict.rationale: ClickHouse exposes a documented public HTTP/SQL API, an OpenAPI spec (clickhouse-probe-3), and an llms.txt for AI-native discovery (clickhouse-probe-1), plus a CLI and official MCP server for programmatic/agentic access. This gives AI-native users multiple documented, machine-consumable interfaces to drive the product. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the OpenAPI/HTTP API from third parties, and more detail on API versioning/stability guarantees.
